<!-- pr-reviewer: 1a650da366f4749b7aa82c84cbca2b515ac5db13 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

The safety review found no blocking defects.

- The post refuses each WireAngle record by operation name. It stops further cutting moves in that section.
- The tests cover positive, negative, and zero angles without WireTaper. The vertical path still posts.
- Issue #1496 permits this result. The decision file states the mapping limits and the rejected options. The PR does not add unconfirmed taper words.
- No UI files, dependencies, build scripts, or workflow files changed. No goldens changed. There are no golden lines to check.

Local checks used worktree `.claude/worktrees/review-1787`. The trial merge with `upstream/main` at `bed96be784d5d106461a8efc5dd0b372034e58bd` had no conflicts. Git reported `Already up to date.` No GitHub runner was used.

`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` passed. It built and ran these suites:

Total: 160 passed, 0 failed, 0 ignored. `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post --all-targets -- -D warnings` also passed.

I ran two mutations in temporary script copies outside the checkout. A temporary Cargo test package used the PR's two tests, its post crate, and dependency versions from its lock file. The tracked code did not change.

1. Use the script from upstream/main, without the new guard: RED. The angle test failed at line 60. It reported `angle 3: []` and showed `T91`, `C110`, and `G01 X-20. Y0.`. The vertical test passed.
2. Keep the warning but remove `sectionOk = false` from the new branch: RED. The angle test failed at line 69. The output still contained `G01 X-20. Y0.`. The vertical test passed.
3. Use the unchanged PR script again: GREEN. Both tests passed.

Requested changes: none.

No physical Sodick control was tested. The Mark 21 / EX21 taper mapping remains unverified and refused.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Fixed both findings from the latest review.

1. WireAngle now persists through section start and is checked in onSection. It resets at section end. `sodick_refuses_angle_words_before_section_start` pins the refusal. `sodick_angle_refusal_resets_at_section_end` pins the reset.
2. The new before-section test covers positive, negative, and zero angles in the app's parameter order. The existing after-section tests remain.

Mutation checks: restoring the old script fails the before-section pin. Removing the reset fails the reset pin. Restoring the fix passes all four tests.

`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` passed. `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post --all-targets -- -D warnings` passed.

New head: 6b9b1c0027ad18816c0d2f7b4b7ed2929b7879a1.

The PR is back in draft. Please re-review this head.

Ready for the maintainer to merge.

The safety review found no blocking defects. Both requests in NeoTech's review of the previous head are complete.

- `WireAngle` sets a flag before section start. `onSection` checks that flag and refuses the section. Section end clears the flag.
- The new test puts `WireAngle` before section start. It covers positive, negative, and zero angles. The reset test checks that the next vertical section can post.
- The tests also cover angle records after section start and a vertical stream without angle records.
- Issue #1496 permits the post to keep the taper refusal if the PR records the mapping limits. The decision file and PR body do this.
- No UI files changed. No goldens changed, so there are no changed golden lines to check. No dependencies, build scripts, or workflow files changed.

All checks ran locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-1787`. The trial merge with `upstream/main` at `085a4717e2aa2d6463f6f4c4a9c085c044fe2592` had no conflicts. No GitHub runner was used.

`cargo clippy -p camcraft-post --all-targets -- -D warnings` passed.

I repeated two mutation checks in temporary copies. A separate test package used the PR's four tests and its post crate. The tracked files did not change.

1. Use the script from `upstream/main`, without the guard: RED. `sodick_refuses_angle_words_before_section_start` failed at line 105. It reported `angle 3: []`. The output contained `T91`, `C110`, and `G01 X-20. Y0.` without a warning.
2. Remove only `angleWord = false` at section end: RED. `sodick_angle_refusal_resets_at_section_end` failed at line 136. It got two warnings instead of one. The second warning refused the valid `Vertical2` section.
3. Restore the unchanged PR script: GREEN. All four tests passed.

Requested changes: none.

No physical Sodick control was tested. The Mark 21 / EX21 taper mapping remains unverified. The post continues to refuse that output.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

@NeoTech: the new head of this PR answers your review. The refusal now also fires in the normal parameter order (see the fix comment and its pinning test). Our safety review on the new head is clean. We leave the merge to you after you check it.

Work: full diff read, trial merge, one local build (camcraft-post suite, 456 tests, clippy). No app build, no runner. Effort label: effort:high. No escalation.
Method: the agent's completion report carries this token total. The report's prose estimate (~85k) counts only the visible working set; the reported total replaces it, same basis as the #1793 rows.
